view_frame: The drawing provides a TOP view in the XY plane and a SECTION view in the XZ plane. The world axes are defined as X (width, 60mm), Y (depth, 40mm), and Z (height, 20mm). The origin (0,0,0) is at the bottom-left-front corner of the tray's outer envelope.

features.shape: Open rectangular tray with rounded vertical corners
features.placement: Outer envelope: X=0 to 60, Y=0 to 40, Z=0 to 20. Inner cavity: X=2 to 58, Y=2 to 38, Z=2 to 20. Corner radii: Outer R6, Inner R4 (6-2).
features.evidence: Top view shows outer and inner rounded rectangles. Section view shows U-shaped profile with uniform wall thickness. Text notes 'Same wall and floor thickness' and 'Thickness value is not given' (resolved by user answer).

connections: Inner cavity is subtracted from the outer solid block.
Inner corner radii are concentric with outer corner radii.
edit_rules: Changing the uniform thickness parameter updates both wall and floor thickness simultaneously.
Changing outer dimensions (X, Y, Z) preserves the uniform thickness.
Changing corner radius updates both outer and inner radii maintaining the thickness offset.
